description: This file defines a set of API endpoints for managing notes, including creating, listing, retrieving, updating, deleting, pinning/unpinning, favoriting/unfavoriting, and managing tags associated with notes. It uses FastAPI for routing, SQLAlchemy for database interactions, and includes utility functions for converting database models to output schemas.

methods.name: NoteOut _note_to_out(db: Session, note: Note, user_id: uuid.UUID)
methods.description: Converts a database Note object to a NoteOut schema, including tags and favorite status for a specific user.

methods.name: NoteOut create_note( payload: NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a new note for the current user.

methods.name: NoteListOut list_notes( db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), archived: Optional[bool] = Query(default=None), pinned: Optional[bool] = Query(default=None), favorite: Optional[bool] = Query(default=None), tag_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = Query(default=None), limit: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=200), offset: int = Query(default=0, ge=0), )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes for the current user with optional filters for archived, pinned, favorited, and tags.

methods.name: NoteOut get_note( note_id: uuid.UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Fetches a specific note by its ID for the current user.

methods.name: NoteOut update_note( note_id: uuid.UUID, payload: NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
None delete_note( note_id: uuid.UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.

methods.name: NoteOut pin_note( note_id: uuid.UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
NoteOut unpin_note( note_id: uuid.UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
NoteOut favorite_note( note_id: uuid.UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Marks a note as a favorite for the current user.

methods.name: NoteOut unfavorite_note( note_id: uuid.UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Removes a note from the current user's favorites.

methods.name: NoteOut set_note_tags( note_id: uuid.UUID, payload: AssignTagsRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Replaces the tags associated with a note, ensuring they belong to the current user.
